plainTranslation: Security pulls against restriction. One reaches for closeness; one withholds it. Can feel like love rationed. Loosen the grip and reassure freely, or admit the coldness is the problem.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
